question: Which unchanged controller operation consumes the actual retained full-run workload cost?
basis: Original V5 46->344/512 wins, but 4015.74 CPU seconds exceeded frozen3600. Query-local cache preserved all bytes but did not establish speedup in its fixed regression. Neither failed condition is reset.
assignment: Exactly original v5-000: two original configurations, four original seeds, planner method. No new root, policy, seed, candidate or outcome search.
measurement: Write-only monotonic timers for whole root planning, public clone, nested RunState.map copy, greedy continuation and leaf evaluation. Counters must cover all original root queries/rollouts. Inclusive map timing is not added a second time to root totals.
validation: Full native trace bytes must equal original. All endpoint and per-action alternatives remain identical after excluding only top-level run_usec/query_usec and the explicitly source-bound instrumented probe hash. No rounding or value tolerance. The same two-sample/twelve-step policy, costs, and signed boundaries remain unchanged.
limits: Instrumented cost is diagnostic, not a speedup or resource admission. It cannot rescue original value-v1, open V0/support or become a new statistical sample.
